sloka: अथ वैडूर्यवर्णेषु शाद्वलेषु महाबलः ।धीरः सलिलकल्पेषु विच्चार यथासुखम् ॥५-१-३॥
transliteration: atha vaiḍūryavarṇeṣu śādvaleṣu mahābalaḥ ।dhīraḥ salilakalpeṣu viccāra yathāsukham ॥5-1-3॥

translations.english: Tawnyhued Hanuman, gifted with extraordinary strength and patience happily strolled on the marshy tracts of grassy land which had the colour of vaidurya.
